CFAN.stands_in_for: the fan cable and the clamp as one capacitance to the reference, both declared budgets rather than measurements

DRIVE.stands_in_for: the controller's compare output as an ideal switch at the standard's target frequency and half duty

FANPULL.stands_in_for: the fan's internal pull-up supply at the highest open-circuit level the standard permits

RDSON.stands_in_for: the open-drain driver as its on-resistance at the 2.5 V gate the datasheet characterises, below the logic rail that actually drives it

RFAN.stands_in_for: the fan's internal pull-up at the strongest the standard permits, which is the value that sources its stated maximum current into a short; the standard sets no lower bound on that current, so a fan with a weaker pull-up releases the line more slowly than this

RSERIES.stands_in_for: the control output's series element at the high end of its tolerance

description: one control output at the standard's target frequency, against the strongest pull-up the standard permits a fan to present and the capacitance the cable and the clamp add
name: control_edge_into_the_fan_pull_up
